title: The passive voice: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.explanationEs: El idioma no habla: se habla. Pasiva en presente: is + participio (spoken).

items.statement: My phone was stolen last night.
items.explanationEs: No importa quién lo robó: pasiva, was + participio (stolen).
The letters es plural: were sent.

answers: The museum is visited by thousands of people.
items.explanationEs: Pasiva en presente: is + participio; quién lo hace va con by.
Pregunta en pasiva: were + sujeto + participio. Did no va con la pasiva.
